images.description: Bright tactile game-show studio with coral Y-pose and mint T-pose foam cutout walls. Generated key art is used in the entrance, discovery and result. Animated wall geometry is rendered in canvas.
images.processing: Source PNG 1024x1536 retained. Cover converted to 768x1152 WebP quality 87; preview to 512x768 WebP quality 83.

music.title: おもちゃの一日
music.creator: いまたく
music.conditions: Creator follows the site license. Commercial game background music use and editing are permitted. No standalone audio distribution or listening feature. No creator-tool provision of the music to secondary users.
music.acquisition: Reused the already downloaded OpenTracks source in this workspace (also used by TOY DRUM). Site license, site terms and creator conditions rechecked on 2026-10-04; the track page was not retrievable by web search. Original acquisition provenance is documented in docs/toy-drum-assets.json.
music.processing: Opening 18 seconds. Stereo MP3 96kbit/s, 44.1kHz; loudnorm target -20 LUFS / -2dB true peak, 50ms fade-in and one-second fade-out.
music.delivery: Vite ?inline import inside a lazy music JS chunk. Follows shared BGM ON/OFF, pause, focus loss, results and exit lifecycle. No standalone MP3 in public/dist.

effects: Original procedural Web Audio: descending wall/approach sweep, rising pop and chord for PERFECT, light sweep for CLEAR, rubbery pitch bends for SQUEEZE, descending sawtooth thud for CRASH. No third-party SE samples.
